scenarios.scenario_abstract: While coordinating organic treatments for mature peach and apple trees from leaf drop and dormancy through bud stages, humid summer intervals, and harvest, [X] needs upper-body work layers that provide reliable spray coverage while remaining practical as cold bare-branch work gives way to warmer, wetter foliage work.
examples: using more insulating coverage for dormant-season spraying
switching to breathable long-sleeved protection during warm humid treatments
keeping pollinator-safe no-spray stages separate from clothing decisions
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为老桃树和苹果树安排从落叶、休眠期一直延续到萌芽、潮湿夏季和采收前的有机防治时，[X]需要上身工作层在喷洒中提供可靠遮护，也能随着寒冷的裸枝作业转向温暖潮湿的枝叶作业，满足整套反复养护周期中的季节变化。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For travel spanning tropical humidity, snowy cold, hot dry days with cold nights, monsoon rain, and large spring or fall temperature swings, [X] builds a compact washable upper-body system in which breathable bases, insulating middle layers, and protective shells receive distinct seasonal roles instead of packing a separate outfit for every destination.
examples: using breathable long sleeves for hot sun and humid conditions
combining a base top with insulation and a shell in winter
removing one layer as a transitional day warms
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为跨越热带湿热、冰雪寒冷、昼热夜冷、季风降雨以及春秋大幅温差的旅行准备上装时，[X]不会为每个目的地各带一套衣服，而会让透气打底、保温中层和防护外层承担不同季节用途，同时维持一套数量有限、便于清洗的轮换。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing a ten-day Tokyo trip, [X] chooses July despite heat, humidity, early-month rain, long daylight, and strongly cooled indoor spaces, requiring tops that stay light outdoors, tolerate repeated warm-weather use, and accept one compact removable layer for trains, shops, and sudden rain.
examples: rotating lightweight breathable tops through humid sightseeing days
carrying one compact layer for air-conditioned interiors
keeping rain readiness separate from unnecessary heavy insulation
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 逐步安排十天东京行程时，[X]在了解炎热、潮湿、七月上旬降雨、日照时间长和室内冷气强等条件后仍选择七月；计划中的上衣需要在户外保持轻薄、经得住暖季反复穿用，并能配合一件便携可脱的层应对列车、商店和突发降雨，而不把夏季行李变成寒季衣橱。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a relaxed three-day spring trip from Barcelona to Marseille and Cassis, [X] and two friends move among city walks, coastal wind, a Calanques outing, restaurants, and possible rain, using a small top rotation for sunny warmth, cooler shade and evenings, a dressier meal, and removable wind or rain protection without overpacking.
examples: wearing a light top for a sunny harbor walk
adding a long-sleeved layer when coastal wind rises
reserving one neater top for dinner without adding a separate wardrobe
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]和两位朋友从巴塞罗那出发，进行三天两夜、节奏宽松的春季马赛与卡西斯旅行，期间会在城市步行、海岸风、峡湾活动、餐厅和可能的降雨之间切换；少量上衣要同时应对晴天午后的温暖、阴影与晚间降温、稍正式的晚餐以及可随时增减的防风防雨层，又不能为短途行程过度打包。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across India's northern winter mornings, very hot pre-monsoon plains, humid coasts, heavy monsoon rain, cooler hills, and post-monsoon transition, [X] prepares tops that also preserve shoulder coverage for religious sites, making suitability depend on fabric, sleeve coverage, drying speed, and layering rather than temperature alone.
examples: layering a warmer top for a cool northern winter morning
using breathable covered tops in dry heat and at religious sites
favoring quick-drying upper layers during monsoon travel
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 比较印度不同地区的天气时，[X]会为北方冬季清晨、季风前的高温平原、潮湿海岸、强降雨季、较凉的山地和季风后的过渡期准备上衣；计划还要在宗教场所保持肩部遮盖，因此季节适配不只由温度决定，也取决于面料、袖部遮护、干燥速度和叠穿方式。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building spring and autumn outfits around one uploaded white T-shirt and jeans, [X] tests the same shirt with a cap, jewelry, bags, sneakers, and proposed denim or trench outerwear across mild standalone weather, cooler layered days, and warm minimalist variations rather than assigning a season from color alone.
examples: wearing the uploaded T-shirt alone on a mild afternoon
adding a denim jacket as a spring or autumn outer layer
keeping the same shirt useful in a lighter summer combination
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 希望一件上传过图片的白色 T 恤能在春秋与牛仔裤同穿时，[X]会反复让它搭配帽子、首饰、包、运动鞋以及候选牛仔夹克或风衣，检验它在温和天气单穿、较凉时叠穿和暖季极简组合中的具体作用，而不是仅凭颜色为它指定季节。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While traveling from Tokyo through Kanazawa, Shirakawa-go, and Takayama in mid-April with a family of four, [X] plans compact upper-layer sequences for heated buses, mild city afternoons, wet walking routes, and near-freezing alpine evenings, plus quickly reachable dry backups for the children during festivals and transfers.
examples: removing a middle layer inside a warm bus
adding thermal and wind-resistant layers for a cold night festival
keeping a dry child-size top accessible after wet outdoor walking
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 四月中旬与一家四口从东京前往金泽、白川乡和高山时，[X]会为有暖气的巴士、温和的城市午后、潮湿步行路线和接近冰点的高地夜晚规划紧凑的上身叠穿顺序，孩子还要有在节庆和转车途中能够快速取用的干燥备用上衣。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For cool mornings, warm afternoons, long school days, and a limited budget, [X] builds one spring-and-fall capsule and compares short- and long-sleeved tops, a white button-down, a cardigan or denim jacket, and a thin sweater by how many temperature transitions and outfit combinations they support rather than isolated fashion appeal.
examples: opening a button-down over a light top as the day warms
using a neutral long-sleeved top across several school outfits
choosing midweight layers that work in both transitional seasons
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为凉爽清晨、温暖午后、漫长上课日和有限预算建立一套春秋共用的胶囊衣橱时，[X]会按能支持多少次温度转换和多少种搭配来比较短袖与长袖上衣、白色纽扣衬衫、开衫或牛仔夹克和薄毛衣，而不是只看单件是否时髦。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cloudy day that feels only slightly cold, [X] tests an owned thin black bomber over a T-shirt, crewneck, or hoodie for enough wind protection without overheating, revealing that the exact piece is most useful during mild transitional weather rather than deep cold or peak heat.
examples: wearing a grey T-shirt beneath the unzipped bomber
adding a hoodie when the breeze feels colder
recognizing when the thin jacket no longer supplies enough insulation
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一个多云、只是略冷的日子里，[X]会围绕已有的一件薄黑色飞行夹克搭配 T 恤、圆领上衣或连帽衫，并判断它能否在不过热的情况下提供足够挡风，从而显现这件熟悉夹克更适合温和的过渡季，而不是严寒或酷暑。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For the full Camino Frances in winter on a solo low budget, [X] faces short daylight, closed lodgings, exposed plateaus, mountain snow or ice, and repeated washing, requiring a very small upper-layer system that separates moisture control, warmth, and rain or wind protection while preserving one dry option for stops.
examples: venting a base and mid layer during a steep climb
adding wind and rain protection on an exposed section
keeping one dry warm top available after a wet walking day
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备独自、低预算在冬季走完整条法国之路时，[X]会面对日照短、部分住宿关闭、高原暴露、山段可能结冰积雪，以及数周内反复清洗衣物，因此极少量上身层必须分别承担排湿、保暖和防风雨作用，又要足够轻便以便每天背负，并在抵达住处时保留一件干燥可穿的上衣。
